testcase.name: completion is emitted once per explicit batch and includes trust failures()
repository changes are checked again before queued work and retries()
retry only repeats failed items and never grants trust()
a timed out item does not prevent other items from finishing()
cancelling before dispatch still finishes the queue()
one exception fails only its item and a new batch starts cleanly()
at most two downloads run and each package is prepared once()
opening or restoring data never starts downloads and consent is mandatory()
cancellation preserves completed items and does not start queued ones()
duplicate packages invalid identities and insecure downloads are rejected before starting()
